story.title: The silver root
story.synopsis: Mara stands beside a leafless tree on a deserted shore, holding a cracked clay bowl containing a single silver root. The silver root grows from the cracked clay bowl and winds around Mara's wrists, joining her hands to the leafless tree. Mara and the leafless tree share a dense tangle of silver roots while the cracked clay bowl opens into a hollow trunk. On the deserted shore Mara holds the cracked clay bowl again, now bearing the small imprint of the tree and one silver root.
